NAMAZ OF IMAM AL-HADI (A)

This prayer consists of two units in the first of which Surahs al-Faatehah and Yasin (No. 36) are recited and in the second of which Surahs al-Faatehah and al-Rahman (No. 55) are recited. After the namaz recite the dua of Imam Al Hadi (a.s.):
